project_type: GNOME desktop customization for Ubuntu White Edition. Additive layer: a GNOME Shell extension (JavaScript) + GSettings schema (XML) + SVG artwork + Bash install script + Markdown design docs.
language: JavaScript (GJS / GNOME Shell extension), plus XML (GSettings schema, SVG), Bash, Markdown.
build_system: No compiled build for this layer. Bash install scripts copy assets into an ISO target root. dconf profiles/keyfiles compiled with 'dconf update'. GSettings schema compiled with 'glib-compile-schemas' at install time.
test_framework: No runtime test harness. Validation is static only: 'node --check' for JS, 'glib-compile-schemas' for schema, 'xmllint --noout' for SVG/XML well-formedness, 'bash -n' for shell scripts, grep for wiring.
build_command: N/A (no compile step). Static validation: node --check on all .js; glib-compile-schemas on schemas dir; xmllint --noout on SVGs and gschema; bash -n on install.sh.
test_command: Static validation suite (see build_command). No live GNOME Shell available in sandbox.
verification_instructions: 1) node --check extension.js && node --check prefs.js. 2) glib-compile-schemas --strict --dry-run schemas/ (schema must compile clean). 3) xmllint --noout on each logo SVG and the gschema.xml. 4) bash -n install.sh. 5) grep-confirm: metadata.json uuid matches directory name; settings-schema id matches gschema id; extension.js and prefs.js read the two keys (start-menu-alignment, start-button-logo); install.sh compiles schema and installs logos.
snapshot_or_generated_files: gschemas.compiled is produced by glib-compile-schemas at install time and must NOT be checked in (repo policy: 'Do not copy compiled dconf databases into the repository'). Same principle applies to compiled schema caches.
setup_instructions: Repo is sparse-checkout (blobless). gnome-source and ubuntu-white already materialized. Node v22, glib-compile-schemas, xmllint, python3 all present in sandbox.
environment_constraints: Network restricted, no apt, no package installs. NO live GNOME Shell / gnome-extensions run possible: cannot verify runtime popup positioning, live GSettings binding, or prefs UI rendering. gnome-extensions CLI absent. Validation is static + review only. Do NOT edit vendored upstream GNOME source under gnome-source/{glib,gtk,mutter,gnome-shell,...}. Repo prose convention: NO em dashes.
contribution_requirements: Additive and reversible (White Edition philosophy: overlays, defaults-not-locks, no silent system changes). db/local.d/00-white-edition entries are DEFAULTS not LOCKS. Explicit allow-lists for installed artwork. Install scripts require an explicit target root and refuse to operate on host / by accident where the existing scripts do so.
key_patterns: Existing install scripts (install-config.sh, theme/install-icons.sh) use: '#!/usr/bin/env bash' + 'set -euo pipefail', ROOT_DIR via 'CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")"', require TARGET_ROOT containing /etc, reject symlinks/special files, 'install -m 0644'. SVGs (ubuntu-white/icons/*.svg) use viewBox, role=img, aria-label, flat fills, palette accent #e95420, chrome #303030/#4a4a4a. Theme palette in theme/white-edition.css: --we-surface #ffffff, --we-surface-raised #fafafa, --we-text #303030, --we-edge #dddddd, --we-red #e95420. README voice is precise, declarative, no marketing.
relevant_files: gnome-source/conf/white-edition/README.md (calls for Shell extension layer for bottom panel; must be updated to reference new extension)
gnome-source/conf/white-edition/theme/install-icons.sh (safe installer conventions: target root, allow-list, symlink rejection)
directory_structure: New extension lives at gnome-source/conf/white-edition/shell-extension/white-edition@mearvk/ with standard GNOME Shell extension files: metadata.json, extension.js, prefs.js, stylesheet.css, schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.white-edition.gschema.xml, logos/*.svg (3 candidates), install.sh, README.md.
